noun_definition: Green dot refers to an indicator shown in the Left Hand Navigation (LHN) that signifies the presence of requested money associated with a deleted workspace, but does not provide a button to settle the request.
lhn refers to the left-hand navigation area where a green dot is displayed, indicating a status related to the workspace in the context of the issue.
Button refers to the interactive element that should allow the user to settle the requested money but is absent in the user interface after performing specific actions.

settle refers to the action of completing a money request transaction, which is expected to be initiated by a button that is missing in the user interface despite the presence of a Green dot indicating a pending action.
